text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 20

Panel composition on its own is close to meaningless. All-women panels occur by chance, by department demographics, or because HR and senior staff in that firm happen to be women. Raising it signals grievance rather than evidence, and it will damage you more than the decision did.

The stated reasoning is also plausible on merit: a group head role is often weighted toward client-facing and commercial ability, where "excellent client relationships" beats two extra project leads. Fifteen years versus eight doesn't settle it.

Do chase the written explanation — that's a legitimate request, and an unexplained refusal is far better evidence than panel sex. Follow up in writing, copying HR, and ask for specific selection criteria and scoring.
